## Squachy explains himself, and a couple of long-standing rough edges get sanded down

The biggest addition here is MORE INFO: a long-press on any LOG entry now offers a MORE INFO button alongside WATCH/HUNT, and the ALERT screen gets its own MORE INFO button in the corner too. The first time you ever open it, Squachy walks you through what RSSI and confidence actually mean; after that (or right away for repeat visits) it explains whatever was actually detected -- what a Flock camera is, why an AirTag matters, that kind of thing. He's animated in there too now, talking and pacing back and forth instead of just standing still.

Also new: a first-boot color-check screen for CYD boards whose panel batch has RGB and BGR swapped (colors show up flipped -- red where blue should be). It walks you through fixing it with pure red/green/blue swatches, and the fix is a persisted setting so it only has to happen once. Screen rotation now survives a power cycle too, instead of always resetting to the default orientation.

A few things also got fixed along the way: a real word-wrap bug that could cut a sentence off mid-word on wide panels, a device label that rendered as a single letter instead of its full name, Squachy's floss dance occasionally looking like his arms detached from his body, and the small running Squachy cameo on the ALERT screen -- which turned out to be more distracting than helpful, so it's gone.

### The actually-useful part
- **Added**: MORE INFO explanations -- a first-time RSSI/confidence primer, then a per-type explanation of whatever was detected, reachable from LOG's long-press menu and from a new MORE INFO button on the ALERT screen
- **Added**: first-boot color-check screen and a persisted RGB/BGR swap setting for CYD panel batches with swapped color order
- **Added**: screen rotation now persists across power cycles instead of resetting to the board default every boot
- **Fixed**: a word-wrap bug that could silently truncate long explanation text mid-word on wide panels
- **Fixed**: a device label with lowercase letters (e.g. "Apple") rendering as just its first letter in the WATCH/HUNT confirm panel
- **Fixed**: Squachy's floss dance move visibly detaching his arms from his body at the extremes of the swing
- **Changed**: removed the small running Squachy cameo from the ALERT screen -- distracting more than helpful
